mapper.insert: INSERT INTO limite_intentos (CLAVE, FIN, INTENTOS) VALUES (#{clave}, #{fin}, 1) AS nuevo ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE INTENTOS = IF(limite_intentos.FIN <= #{ahora}, 1, limite_intentos.INTENTOS + 1), FIN = IF(limite_intentos.FIN <= #{ahora}, nuevo.FIN, limite_intentos.FIN)
mapper.select: SELECT FIN, INTENTOS FROM limite_intentos WHERE CLAVE = #{clave}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM limite_intentos WHERE FIN <= #{ahora} LIMIT 1000
